fields.description: The company ExportFlow operates under. Leave blank to use the site default company.
fields.label: ExportFlow Company

fields.description: Shown in the app's top-left navigation and on every print's exporter block.
fields.label: Company Logo

fields.description: Height of the logo in the top-left navigation, in pixels.
fields.label: Nav Logo Height (px)

fields.description: Printed on every export document (§5.2)
fields.label: Exporter Identity

fields.description: Address block as it should appear on invoices and declarations
fields.label: Exporter Address

fields.description: When set, invoices carry the declaration "Supply meant for export under LUT without payment of IGST"
fields.label: Letter of Undertaking

fields.description: The exporter's collection bank — printed in the "Bank details" box on every commercial invoice for the buyer's remittance.
fields.label: Bank Details

fields.description: Branch name / address
fields.label: Branch

fields.description: Correspondent / intermediary bank and routing, for inward foreign remittance.
fields.label: Correspondent Bank

fields.description: Leave blank to use the standard SCOMET non-applicability wording
fields.label: SCOMET Declaration Text

fields.description: RBI FEMA merchanting-trade windows. Defaults: complete within 9 months, forex outlay within 4. FEM Export/Import Regs 2026 (effective 1 Oct 2026) may revise these.
fields.label: Merchanting (MTT) Clocks

fields.description: Whole merchanting trade must complete within this many months of commencement.
fields.label: Completion window (months)

fields.description: Forex outlay (import payment ahead of export receipt) may not exceed this many months.
fields.label: Forex-outlay window (months)

fields.description: When a shipment's trade type is Third-country / Merchanting, set its CHA to "Third Country" automatically (a merchanting trade has no Indian customs agent).
fields.label: Set CHA to "Third Country" on merchanting shipments

fields.description: When a Commercial Invoice is generated, automatically open an "Awaiting Realization" Export Realization for the shipment (idempotent; the FEMA due date is filled once the shipment departs). Applies to merchanting trades too.
fields.label: Auto-create the bank realization when a Commercial Invoice is generated

fields.description: One consolidated email per day to every export user (needs an outgoing email account)
fields.label: Send Daily Email Digest
From email address
fields.description: The address outbound emails (PO / proforma) are sent from. Self-contained — does not change the site's default email.

fields.label: App password
fields.description: An app-specific password (e.g. a Google App Password), stored encrypted.

When a Commercial Invoice is generated, automatically open a Pending Export Incentive shell for each scheme the shipment is booked to claim (RoDTEP / Duty Drawback), pre-filled with the FOB basis and booked rate. Never applies to merchanting trades (ineligible).
fields.label: Auto-create incentive claims when a Commercial Invoice is generated

fields.description: Receive purchased goods into a warehouse via a Goods Receipt Note (stock in), and post stock out when the shipment departs. Merchanting trades never carry stock. Off by default — when off, the app stays in pure drop-ship mode.
fields.label: Maintain stock through Goods Receipt Notes

fields.description: Block a non-merchanting shipment from completing its departure milestone until a Goods Receipt Note has received the goods it ships. Leave off during rollout.
fields.label: Require a Goods Receipt Note before a shipment can depart
